item.title: IND v SA 2025: WATCH- Rohit Sharma claps as Virat Kohli celebrates 52nd ton; fan runs in to touch his feet
item.description: Virat Kohli was the toast of the ongoing first ODI between India and South Africa that got underway on November 30, 2025, at the JSCA Stadium in Ranchi. South Africa won the toss and chose to bowl first. Yashasvi Jaiswal fell for 18 runs, but then Virat Kohli added 136 runs for the second wicket with Rohit Sharma (57). item.title: IND v SA 2025: Cricket fraternity applauds Virat Kohli’s masterful 135 as India posts 349/8 in 1st ODI
item.description: India and South Africa will face off in the first one-day international of the three-match series on November 30, 2025, at the JSCA Stadium in Ranchi. KL Rahul leads India in the absence of regular captain Shubman Gill and vice-captain Shreyas Iyer, who are both injured. Temba Bavuma also missed out after Aiden Markram won the toss and chose to bowl first.
